_readme: Every number is {value, unit, src, kind}. kind = sourced (straight from source) | derived (calculated from sourced numbers, formula given) | proxy (real data from a nearby/similar place) | assumption (no public data found — replace with field data). src ids map to DATA_SOURCES.md.

twoWheeler.note: 87 lakh 2W / 1.28 crore total. Registered fleet, not on-road counts.

other.note: autos, buses, goods, etc. Split this using the S8 CSV.

twoWheeler.note: dynamic PCU, time-headway method, Kerala intersections

coefficient.unit: PCU/hour of green per m of approach width

vehicleMix_onRoad._note: Share of vehicles on the road (not registered). 'bus' stands for bus/other and uses the bus PCU and length.

twoWheeler.note: Between S7 registered (68%) and S10 on-road counts (39–44%). Replace with a video count.
No Gurugram on-road data. More cars than Bengaluru (see gurugram-monday-peak.vehicleMix).
Typical length. Replace with a measured value if one is found.

idm._note: Intelligent Driver Model parameters (S16 standard values). Per real vehicle; scaling.spritePlatoon says how they scale for a 10-vehicle sprite.

sd.note: Each sprite's desired speed = scenario traffic speed x normal(1, sd).

twoWheeler.note: Two-wheelers ride faster than the stream.

bus.note: Buses are slower than the stream.

amber_s.note: Picked from the IRC 3–6 s range.

allRed_s.note: Picked from the IRC 1–2 s range. Intergreen = amber + all-red = 5 s.

offsetJ1toJ2_s.note: Uncoordinated: both cycles start at t = 0. Typical of Indian signals.

signalPlans._note: Green windows as [start, end) in seconds of cycle time. Amber follows each green. Silk Board windows are keyed by arm name; the generic plan is keyed by arm role (in/out/left/right, see a scenario's geometry._readme).

BTM_Layout.note: Phase A. Duration 150 s from S5; placement in the cycle is assumed.

HSR_Layout.note: Phase B, 90 s (S5). Starts 90 s into BTM, not 60 s as first proposed: a 60 s overlap is what makes the cycle total 285 s with three 5 s intergreens (150 + 90 - 60 + 45 + 45 + 15 = 285). Starting at 60 s would overlap 90 s and leave 30 s unused.

Hosur_S.note: 45 s (S5), after a 5 s intergreen. Then 5 s intergreen to 285.

fourPhase150._note: For junctions with no public timing: Rajiv Chowk, Subhash Chowk and both J2s. Asked for: main 60, cross 1 = 35, cross 2 = 25, cross 3 = 15, minus intergreens. Those add to 135 s, and with four 5 s intergreens they would need 155 s. So the 130 s of green left in a 150 s cycle is split in the same 60:35:25:15 ratio and rounded: 58 / 34 / 24 / 14. Main road = the ambulance's arm (in); cross 1 = the opposite arm (out); cross 2 = left; cross 3 = right.

cycle_s.note: No public timing. Time 5 cycles from a video or on site.

peak.note: Used where no count exists: volume per arm = v/c x saturation flow x green/cycle, then PCU -> vehicles with the scenario mix.

j1ThroughToJ2.note: Share of J1's main-road (in arm) traffic that continues to J2. The other 40% turn off at J1. J1's cross streets do not feed J2, and J2's cross streets are independent.

cycleMax_s.note: Real junctions exceed this, e.g. Silk Board 285 s (S5)

perceptionReaction_s.note: average; IRC design value for stopping sight distance is 2.5 s

sirenEffectiveRange_urbanIntersection_m.note: <= 40 ft (1977 US DOT study cited in S13)

laneChange_s.note: Time to move out of the middle lane once reacting.

compliance.note: Share of middle-lane drivers who move over when they see the blue light.

yieldShare.note: 1 - 0.62 (ambulance drivers who say motorists don't yield). Applies only inside the siren range. The siren still sounds when the system is on.

triggerDistance_m.note: distance at which the Bengaluru pilot device turns the signal green. Use it as the J1 blink radius.

n1PrewarnDistance_m.note: J2 goes steady blue at the same moment J1 starts blinking (n+1 rule from the concept PDF)

gpsInterval_s.note: Concept: the ambulance unit sends a packet every 1–2 s. Midpoint.

clearedDuration_s.note: amber 3 + all-red 2 (signalTiming_chosen). Then the junction returns to the phase that was interrupted, with its remaining green.

passedRule.value: rear of ambulance crosses the far edge of the junction box
passedRule.note: Box depth along the route = width of the cross road (left + right lanes x lane width).

alertEntryRule.value: conflicting greens go amber then all-red before the ambulance's arm turns green
alertEntryRule.note: Same intergreen as everywhere else (5 s). If the ambulance's arm is already green, it stays green. Not stated in the concept; added for safety.

buildings._note: Heights for OSM buildings in the 3D city (S20). Use the OSM 'height' tag when present, else these rules in order.

metresPerLevel.note: Height = 3 m x building:levels when only levels are tagged.

randomHeightRange_m.note: No height or levels tag: seeded random height in this range (seed: global.simulation.seed + OSM id), so the city looks the same every run. Visual only; not used by the simulation.

queue._note: How the Junction page measures a queue from engine state. Display only; the simulation does not use it.

queuedBelow_kmh.note: A sprite counts as queued below this speed, starting from the stop line and running back while each sprite behind is also this slow. Close to the common traffic-engineering convention of about 5 mph; not taken from a scenario source.

idm.value: global.idm car values (a, b, delta, s0, T), single vehicle, not a sprite

signals.value: ignores red in both modes (emergency right of way); it is slowed only by vehicles ahead
signals.note: So 'without system' delay comes from queues that don't clear, not from the ambulance waiting at an empty red.

dt_s.note: Engine step. 1.6 s and 3 s are exact multiples.

warmUp_cycles.note: Ambulance enters after one full cycle of J1, so queues have formed. Both modes use the same warm-up.

maxDuration_s.note: Safety stop. A run that hits it reports that the ambulance did not get through.

keyframeInterval_s.note: Snapshot spacing for scrubbing; seeking replays from the nearest one. No effect on results.

seed.note: Default random seed. With and without system share it.

carFollowingModel.note: Intelligent Driver Model. Each vehicle gets its own desired speed, so they don't all move at the same pace.

floodSpeedFunction.unit: w = water depth in mm, v = max safe speed in km/h; impassable at w >= 300

scenarios.title: Off-peak, clear night — Bengaluru, Hosur Road
scenarios.purpose: Control case: shows the system working with almost no traffic in the way

junctions.J2: Next signal north on Hosur Road (verify on Maps)

corridorFreeFlowSpeed_kmh.note: TomTom 10 km time 36:09 / (1 + 0.744 congestion) = ~20.7 min per 10 km

volumeFactor.note: Night volume = 25% of the S5 count, per arm. Replace with a count.

cycle_s.note: Silk Board's measured cycle and S5 splits (global.signalPlans.silkBoard). The night timing may differ.

geometry.note: Same J1 (Silk Board), and J2 is assumed to be the same junction as the rain scenario's J2 (both are 'next signal north on Hosur Road'). Confirm, then measure once for both.

sim._note: What the engine reads for this scenario. Refs without a 'global.' or 'scenarios.' prefix are relative to this scenario.

ambulanceSpeed_noSystem_kmh.note: No ambulance speed data for night. Same as traffic in both modes, so only the signals make a difference.

scenarios.title: Monday 6 pm peak — Gurugram, NH-48 → Sohna Road towards Medanta

junctions.J1: Rajiv Chowk (verify it is still signalised at grade)

corridorSpeed_kmh.note: TomTom New Delhi metro, evening rush. TomTom has no separate Gurugram index.

congestionAt6pm.note: 192% extra travel time vs free flow

cycle_s.note: no public timing for these junctions. Time 5 cycles from a video or on site.

approachWidth_m.note: 3 lanes x 3.5 m. Measure on Maps.

vehicleMix.value: use bengaluru mix with car share +10 pts
vehicleMix.note: no Gurugram on-road data found. Superseded by global.vehicleMix_onRoad.gurugram (sim.vehicleMix).

ambulanceWithSystem_kmh.note: cleared middle lane on an urban arterial. A signal-free green corridor, IGI→Medanta, covered 12 km in 6 min (S4), so 35 is conservative.

j1ToJ2_m.note: Measured in src/geo along geometry.osm.routeWay between the two junctions (513.5 m), replacing the 3000 m placeholder. Real map distance, but on the stand-in corridor (see geometry.osm.coverage), not Rajiv Chowk -> Subhash Chowk.

osm._readme: Where src/geo puts the engine's straight route on the map. Way ids are from the export in /data/osm (S20).

coverage.note: The export covers Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Road around Sector 39. It has no NH-48 or Sohna Road ways and nothing named Rajiv Chowk or Subhash Chowk, so J1 and J2 sit on that road's two non-residential crossings. Re-export the real Rajiv Chowk -> Subhash Chowk corridor, then update these way ids and j1ToJ2_m.

routeWay.note: One-way carriageway, lanes=3, running NE -> SW. The only direction with at least 1000 m of mapped road before J1.

opposingWay.note: The other carriageway (SW -> NE). Carries the inbound traffic of J1.out and J2.out.

J1.note: Shaheed Major Vikas Yadav Marg, both carriageways. J1 centre = midpoint of where they cross routeWay. Drawn straight through: the scenario's turn at J1 (ambulanceMovement.atJ1) has no road to follow in this export.

crossArms.value: perpendicular to the route, left of centre
crossArms.note: Cross-arm traffic is drawn on straight lines at right angles to the route; the real cross roads meet it at roughly 80-85 degrees. Each direction keeps to the left (India drives on the left).

j1ToJ2Tolerance_m.note: src/geo refuses to draw if the OSM J1 -> J2 length differs from j1ToJ2_m by more than this.

in.note: Matches signal.approachWidth_m (10.5 m = 3 x 3.5 m). NH-48 arm.

left.note: Placeholder. Arm layout at Rajiv Chowk not verified.
Cross street at Subhash Chowk. Placeholder.

downstreamOfJ2.note: Medanta (destination) is not drawn; the run ends here.

distanceBeforeJ1_m.note: 240 m of NORMAL before the 760 m trigger (S14).

atJ1.note: The route NH-48 -> Sohna Road implies a turn at Rajiv Chowk. Turn direction not verified. If Rajiv Chowk is grade-separated (see junctions.J1), this at-grade J1 may not exist.

atJ2.note: Continues along Sohna Road towards Medanta.

sim._signalNote: The 'signal' block above (150 s cycle, 10.5 m approach, v/c 0.95) applies to both J1 and J2.

scenarios.title: Heavy rain, evening — Bengaluru, Silk Board → Hosur Road

junctions.J2: Next signal towards Madiwala / St John's Hospital (verify)

silkBoardPeakSpeed_kmh.note: 2017 CTSTP study, lowest in the city

corridorSpeed_rain_kmh.note: ORR after ~2 h of rain. One observed event.

waterDepth_mm.note: puddled lane. Gives max safe speed 24.3 km/h via S9.

volume_vehPerHr_total.note: 9:30–10:30 am. Used as a proxy for evening.

ambulanceBaseline_noSystem_kmh.note: Siren only: stuck at the observed rain traffic speed (S2).

ambulanceWithSystem_kmh.note: capped by the flood-depth safe speed at 150 mm

geometry._readme: Arms are named by role relative to the ambulance: in (it arrives on this arm), out (it leaves on this arm), left, right. 'name' maps a role to a real arm where a source names it. Lane counts are inbound lanes; outbound assumed equal.

j1ToJ2_m.note: Placeholder, not measured. J2 itself is not confirmed yet (see junctions.J2). Measure along Hosur Road on Maps or OSM.

laneWidth_m.note: Same lane width the Gurugram approachWidth note uses (3 x 3.5 m).

in.name: Hosur_S
in.note: Smallest count that lets S5's 2,379 veh/h discharge in a 45 s green of a 285 s cycle under S11: 2379 x 0.606 PCU/veh x 285/45 = 9,137 PCU/h of green -> 17.4 m -> 5.0 lanes. 0.606 = registered mix (S7) x PCU (S10), with 'other' taken at the auto PCU. Read as effective lanes; traffic here is not lane-disciplined.

out.name: Hosur_N
out.note: Same check as Hosur_S (same volume and green).

left.name: BTM_Layout
left.note: Same check: 8300 x 0.606 x 285/150 = 9,563 PCU/h of green -> 18.2 m -> 5.2 lanes. Left/right side of BTM vs HSR (travelling north) to verify on Maps.

right.name: HSR_Layout
right.note: Same check: 4758 x 0.606 x 285/90 = 9,137 PCU/h of green -> 17.4 m -> 5.0 lanes.

in.note: Same road as J1 Hosur_N, kept equal so lanes run straight through the J1-J2 link.

left.note: Cross street at an unconfirmed junction. Pure placeholder.

upstreamOfJ1.note: Must exceed global.system.triggerDistance_m (760) so every run opens in NORMAL before J1 alerts.

downstreamOfJ2.note: Enough to see the ambulance clear J2 and J2 return to NORMAL.

crossArms.note: Applies to left/right arms at both junctions. BTM red-phase queues may exceed this; the engine needs an off-screen queue store.

distanceBeforeJ1_m.note: Start of the drawn upstream approach: 240 m of NORMAL before the 760 m trigger (S14). Middle lane = index floor(lanes/2), so lane counts on the route must be odd.

atJ1.note: Hosur_S -> Hosur_N, read from the title 'Silk Board -> Hosur Road' towards Madiwala. Verify the direction of travel.

scenarios.title: Monsoon waterlogging — Gurugram (optional, extreme case)

observedSlowdown.value: 5–7 min trip took 90 min (Atlas Chowk → DLF Cyber Park); 5 min took 60 min (Udyog Vihar Ph 3 → Shankar Chowk)

scenarios.purpose: Honest limit case: shows what the system can't fix (a flooded road)

geometry.note: This scenario names no junctions, so it reuses the Monday-peak corridor, geometry and signals.

trafficSpeed_kmh.note: Capped by the S9 flood speed at waterDepth_mm (about 5 km/h at 250 mm).

ambulanceSpeed_withSystem_kmh.note: Capped by the flood speed. This is the case the system can't fix.

vehiclesPerSprite.note: Silk Board at 17,816 veh/h gives ~140 sprites per 285 s cycle

timeCompression.note: one 285 s cycle ≈ 19 s on screen. Always show a 'real time' clock.

spritePlatoon._note: 1 sprite = vehiclesPerSprite vehicles of one type, drawn as a short platoon. The engine moves platoons with IDM at true scale, so the queue on screen is the queue the engine computes.

packing.note: Platoon length = 10 x vehicle length x 0.4. Stands in for mixed traffic filling gaps sideways. The IDM jam gap s0 is packed the same way (10 x s0 x 0.4) so a standing queue is 10 x 0.4 x (length + s0) per sprite: 24.8 m for 10 cars, against 62 m single-file.

timeHeadwayFactor.note: Sprite IDM time headway = 10 x T, so moving sprites keep the spacing 10 vehicles would. Steady flow then matches S11 at normal speeds.

stopLineCapacity.value: S11 per lane: 525 x lane width PCU per hour of green
stopLineCapacity.note: A sprite crosses on green only once its lane has built up its PCU in green time (unused capacity carries over, capped at one bus sprite = 22 PCU). Without this, a 10-vehicle block clears a short green in seconds. Measured in src/engine/engine.test.ts: an oversaturated Gurugram arm discharges 0.82x S11. In the rain scenario it is about 0.5x, because 4.8 km/h desired speeds limit flow.

scaling.speedRatiosMustStayTrue: Scale time, not speeds relative to each other. A 4.8 km/h scene must look 6x slower than a 29 km/h scene.
